task.title: Genbeya's Git tools in VS Code
task.body:
Genbeya's Git tools are more intuitive and more capable than VS Code's built-in ones. Offer them as a view of their own, natively where possible.

- [ ] Decide what to offer next to VS Code's Source Control instead of replacing it
- [ ] Changes as a tree with staging of lines, amend, ignore
- [ ] History with branches, tags and stashes; reset, revert, cherry-pick
- [ ] Merge, rebase (interactive too) and conflict resolution
- [ ] Push with upstream and force with lease
